notes: Two sources only, both ESPEC North America pages (snapshots research/v5/cache/f56c92956c6d509c.txt = model page, research/v5/cache/d2daf4bba5d454ea.txt = family page; the linked 'EXT Brochure' PDF URL is not exposed in the page text). Floor-standing painted box cabinet 985 W x 1193 D x 2054 H mm with ONE full-opening front door (family page says two doors except 'one door on 2.0 models'); stainless interior 685 x 685 x 736 mm (233 L). Thermal system: LN2 injected through vacuum-jacketed valves/manifold (proportional manifold is optional on 2.0, so standard is on/off solenoid valves), nichrome heaters in an overhead plenum, high-velocity recirculating air; -100 to 200 C, 70 C/min empty, 208/230 V 1ph 70 A. No vacuum, no magnet. Standard configuration has no window (cabinet option 'Windows and ports' not fitted) and no sample feedthrough ports; the only documented sample-side signal path is the PLC's four spare thermocouple input channels (product thermocouple is an instrumentation option). For the 3D model: single-zone box with a door on the front face, plenum at the top of the interior containing heaters and LN2 injection, air circulating downward over the workspace; an LN2 supply line (Dewar or bulk tank) enters from outside. The PLC/desktop PC with flat panel monitor is a separate item whose dimensions are not published.
